title: Tired of Market Noise? Meet Trade Pulse – Your AI Trading Signal & Sentiment Hub
author: Enough_Ad8476
selftext:
I've been tracking stocks, gold, oil and Bitcoin over the last few weeks and one thing stands out.

Despite all the geopolitical headlines, markets haven't reacted the way many expected.

Gold has held up well, oil has seen volatility but not a sustained breakout, and equities remain surprisingly resilient.

It makes me wonder whether investors are focusing too much on the headlines and not enough on liquidity, earnings and interest rate expectations.

Curious what everyone else is watching right now. Are you positioning defensively or still expecting risk assets to move higher through the second half of the year?
